Simulation Zoo.name: Simulation Zoo
Simulation Zoo.summary: Simulation Zoo is, as the name suggests, a business simulation game similar to the well-known Theme Park, in which the player operates and manages a zoo. The player is a new CEO brought in to turn around a failing zoo, maintaining and expanding facilities, balancing income and expenses, and acquiring new exhibits. The game is viewed from an isometric perspective and proceeds in real-time. There are eight different scenarios to choose from, each focusing on a different biome such as river valley, jungle, or desert.

Time Commando.name: Time Commando
Time Commando.summary: A deadly virus has invaded the military's top secret computer. Thrust into a deadly time warp. You must battle your way through history and the future, racing against time to restore the computer memory before a growing computer virus becomes invincible. Prepare yourself of the most brutal trip through time ever.
